# jamfplatform_pro_advanced_computer_search (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro advanced computer search by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Create the API integration with **Platform environment** scope (preferred) or **Tenant** scope, then grant it the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inventory | Advanced device searches | Read | `advanced-device-searches` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an advanced computer search by ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_advanced_computer_search" "by_id" {
  id = "461"
}

# Look up an advanced computer search by exact name.
data "jamfplatform_pro_advanced_computer_search" "by_name" {
  name = "Lab Macs running Sequoia"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Advanced computer search ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Advanced computer search display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `criteria` (Attributes List) Ordered criteria evaluated by Jamf Pro to populate the search. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria))
- `display_fields` (Set of String) Inventory column names shown in the search results.
- `site_id` (String) Jamf Pro site ID scoping the search. `-1` means no site (`NONE`).
- `site_name` (String) Jamf Pro site display name.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria`

Read-Only:

- `and_or` (String)
- `has_closing_parenthesis` (Boolean)
- `has_opening_parenthesis` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `priority` (Number)
- `search_type` (String)
- `value` (String)
